message: 越後屋は誰だ!?

name: Synn
message: 「For the Manga Research Society and the Light Music Club, it's a refund of club funds and three months of volunteer work for the ringleaders」

name: Synn
message: 「And the Gardening Club settled on a full refund of their club funds, plus providing their harvested fruits and vegetables to the academy during the school festival...」

name: Misa
message: 「To think they were secretly cultivating matsutake and king oyster mushrooms to turn a profit... how shocking」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm just glad we caught it before some bizarre bacteria leaked out of the lab and turned the academy into a zombie nest」

name: Paqy
message: 「You'd be dead meat long before any zombies showed up」

name: Ria
message: 「I really didn't think any of the students would do anything dishonest, so this is a shock」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unlike angels, humans are inherently wicked, though still better than Demons」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, I'd say angels are plenty full of poison in their own subtle way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「M-Mr. Panda! P-Please stop spouting nonsense as if you actually know any angels!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, the Gardening Club only started turning a profit this year, right? None of this is your fault, Senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai, what was last year's treasurer like?」

name: Ria
message: 「She was a certified public accountant's daughter who was great with numbers, someone you could completely trust with the books」

name: Synn
message: 「If she's someone you vouched for as trustworthy, Ria-senpai, then there's nothing to worry about」

name: Ria
message: 「You're right. Silly me, the Student Council isn't mine alone, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That was a sigh big enough to swallow a hippo. Did you make a mistake or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, n-no. I don't think so. I took everything home yesterday and checked it all properly with an abacus」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What? Why are you looking at me like I'm some rare beast?」

name: Misa
message: 「...I'm just surprised that appearances really can be deceiving」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Not being able to just admit you're impressed is classic for a hysterical chick who stirs up trouble and makes everything prickly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I only did what anyone would do. It's a job that deals with money, so being extra careful is just common sense, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「With you like this, this year's accounting will be in good hands.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka has always been reliable, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehehe. Flattering me won't get you anything, you know... *Sigh*...」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be... Nanaka-san, are you still hung up on that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something just feels off about it...」

name: Misa
message: 「That was settled yesterday, wasn't it? If you want to be promoted from a society to an official club, you have to steadily build up a track record and earn that promotion.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You can't just eat all the time. Those who do not work shall not eat.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though those guys do nothing but eat at Prier too...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Dumplings over flowers, indeed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, the Wagashi Club is effectively a society too, so aren't they on the same footing as your Sweets Society, Nanaka-san?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, even if they got demoted to a society, there's no chance the Sweets Society would become an official club with a budget... Oh, wait, what about the Gardening Club's budget...」

name: Misa
message: 「I was a fool for almost thinking better of you\s10」

name: Synn
message: 「Like she said, you can't get promoted without actual club activities.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat?! Don't make it sound like we haven't accomplished anything at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whenever we hear a new Western pastry shop opened to the east, we're the first ones rushing over--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And whenever we hear a new menu item appeared to the west, we immediately take on the challenge with iron stomachs, never leaving a single crumb, always--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really do just eat all the time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... B-But even those guys in the Wagashi Club were buying such expensive sweets at Prier and showing them off... Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it, something's fishy! Something's going on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna go check at Prier!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「? Treasurer, what is it that you 'knew'?」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Whoa! Why are you here, Synn?! Wait, Misa too!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's my line」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shh, keep it down. It'll be bad if they notice us before we get the evidence」

name: Synn
message: 「Evidence?」
Sitting at a table a short distance from the shadow of the pillar where we were hiding, Misasagi-senpai and the members of the 'Wagashi Club' were chatting happily while drinking sencha.

name: Lolotte
message: 「To me, the Wagashi Club members only look like they are eating sweets」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, buying that many different kinds must cost quite a bit...」
All of the wagashi were tiny, compact like intricate handicrafts, and so pretty it almost felt like a waste to eat them.

name: Nanaka
message: 「If they bought them, sure」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never mind buying or not buying, Prier doesn't even have wagashi on the menu」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat. Then does that mean those are being specially made for them?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is favoritism」

name: Misa
message: 「What is going on? Are they using Prier for their own private purposes? Even though this place is funded by our tuition...」

name: Synn
message: 「If they're being allowed special treatment like that, this goes way beyond club budget issues」

name: Misa
message: 「It's corruption, pure corruption. But since when? And how?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...We'd probably find out if we asked Bubuzuke directly, wouldn't we?」
I looked over toward Misasagi-senpai.
With a thoroughly satisfied look on his face, Senpai

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not bad at all」
muttered.

name: Ria
message: 「Welcome ba~ck」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Everyone's looking pretty gloomy……」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, no……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「……Witnessing an act of fraud firsthand really leaves a bad taste in one's mouth, doesn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's the Wagashi Club, if you please」

name: Synn
message: 「It's unlocked, so come on in」

name: Ria
message: 「Why is she here again?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Pardon the intrusion」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, um. Sorry to make you come all this way right after yesterday. Please, have a seat over there」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then I won't hold back and will gladly take a seat」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh dear me. The atmosphere is even more tense than yesterday, isn't it. I'm really not too fond of this sort of thing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I would've preferred something way more lighthearted too」

name: Misasagi
message: 「So, what might this be about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your club isn't cooking the books…… but you are pulling some shady stunts at Prier, aren't you」
Misasagi-senpai snapped open her folding fan with a sharp flick.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now I wonder…… whatever could you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've thought it was weird for a while now. You guys gorge yourselves on expensive wagashi at Prier, and I always wondered where on earth that money was coming from. Makes total sense if you're eating for free, though」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As I told you yesterday as well. It's not for free」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't lie. You didn't pay a single cent」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. That is certainly true」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How are you tricking the staff at Prier? I want to eat them too, so please tell me」

name: Misa
message: 「What's a Student Council officer doing wanting to commit fraud?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Haa... Madam President. Your officers really lack proper training」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, she just took the position」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, why are you two having such a casual chat! First of all, Prier doesn't even sell Japanese sweets」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How are only you people getting your hands on things they don't sell?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It sure is mysterious how things that don't exist are right here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just brush it off as mysterious!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh dear. We're not doing anything crooked, you know. We're just cooperating with the academy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's an accomplice to misconduct within the academy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So there's a crooked merchant behind this!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「No, no. There's talk of adding Japanese sweets to Prier's menu, see. So they decided to make something that'll please the customers as a proper product」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And to improve the flavor, we simply happened to be chosen as the taste-testers. That's the honest truth」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so that's what it was」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truly, truly」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't just buy that! Even when they added more Western sweets to the menu, no taste-testing offer ever came our way」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's just because your antenna has poor reception, so you can't catch these opportunities. If you keep thinking so negatively all the time, you'll burst a blood vessel in your brain」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not falling for that. Prier is funded by tuition, so naturally, the cost of those ingredients comes out of our money」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if it's for taste-testing, there's no way a select group should get special treatment to gobble it all up for free」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even so, we just caught wind that Prier was looking for students to do taste-testing and pitched ourselves to them, so don't go blaming us so meanly」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you heard the same rumor about Western sweets, wouldn't you pitch yourselves too? We're both food-related clubs, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't change the subject. Besides, when it comes to clubs that go in and out of Prier, the Cooking Research Society is at the top of the list, so taste-testing offers should go to them first. At least, that's how it's always been until now」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin said so」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see. Sacchin was in that club last year, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though Sacchin only specialized in eating」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of Nanaka-san's friend」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...My club and yours basically just eat, we don't have those kinds of connections at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So why is it that this time, of all times, the offer went to you guys instead of the Cooking Research Club」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Render unto Caesar what is Caesar's, and unto Japanese sweets what is Japanese sweets'--somethin' like that, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do you know someone on the Prier staff?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Who knows? That's a trade secret」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you don't have a guilty conscience, couldn't you at least give me a name?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Since I don't have a guilty conscience, there's no need to give a name, is there?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This feels just like a suspense drama. My heart's pounding」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen. You guys are the ones under suspicion! It's not like I hate you or anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You might have the wrong idea, but even if I knocked you guys down, it's not like our society could get promoted to an official club anyway」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, it couldn't?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it couldn't!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then you don't even need to know, do ya」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I just want to make sure there's no foul play! As long as you tell me who your source is, I don't intend to do anything beyond that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As treasurer, I just want to be satisfied with the explanation. You can at least give me a name, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you only tell me, that's fine. I'll keep it a secret. If there really wasn't any foul play, I won't tell anyone」

name: Misa
message: 「You can't just decide that on your own--」

name: Synn
message: 「That's fine with me. As long as it proves there's no foul play」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Whew...」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, Nanaka-chan. About this--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Stay quiet, Lia」

name: Ria
message: 「No. It's fine now」

name: Ria
message: 「You see, Nanaka-chan. The one who asked Prier to put Japanese sweets on the menu was, um... me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehh?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, as president, I'd go talk to the folks at Prier about once every three months to pass along requests from the students」

name: Ria
message: 「And then, when I casually let slip that since they have Western sweets, it'd be nice to have Japanese sweets too, they decided to go ahead with it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Why are you bringing this up now? Or rather, there wasn't really any need to hide it in the first place」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I told ya that you didn't have to say anything, Ria. Honestly, what am I gonna do with you」

name: Misa
message: 「Um... I'm afraid I can't quite follow the conversation」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ya see, until Ria became Student Council president, she was a member of our Wagashi Club」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thing is, this girl is way too serious for her own good. She said that once she became president, she couldn't belong to any specific club, and went and quit」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not an actual rule or anything. I just thought that since I became president, having ties to one specific club might look bad. You have to draw the line somewhere」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it, Senpai. It's just like how I quit my milk delivery job」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty sure that's different」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, loving wagashi is just her personal taste, so that couldn't be helped. That's why, when Prier reached out to us, it clicked right away that Ria had put in a word for us」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Given her position, she did it on the sly, so I figured thanking her openly would put her in a tough spot and kept quiet about it」

name: Ria
message: 「I should have told you sooner... I'm sorry, Nanaka-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, does that somehow make me the bad guy?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't know, so it can't be helped」

name: Synn
message: 「Next time I meet with the people from Prier, I'll ask them to leave the taste-testing for new Western sweets to the "Sweets Club"」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... That's Lord Synn for you. He sure knows the choices that make a woman happy」

name: Misasagi
message: 「He's quite a fine president, isn't he? No wonder Ria's always talking about him」

name: Misa
message: 「You're always talking about him?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not always talking about him\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'd say we talk quite a bit, wouldn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Do we... really?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, I believe our business is concluded... Now, might I take my leave?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Everything is clear. Apologies for calling you out all this way」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Think nothing of it, that is your duty, after all. Terribly sorry for the intrusion」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nanaka. Forgive me for putting you through the trouble」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing... It's my job」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You, my dear. I'm quite certain you'll make a fine treasurer」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even I don't always speak in riddles, you know. What I just said is the honest truth」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Thank you. Still, I'd rather you didn't cause me any more trouble」
Misasagi-senpai gave a small laugh.

name: Misasagi
message: 「One more thing. The next time you come to Prier, instead of hiding in the shadows, do come join us at our table. You'll be most welcome. Prier's sweets aren't half bad, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Just as I thought. You really do have a nasty streak」
